assessments.reasoning: The retained Go 1.23.0 cgo documentation assigns the adjacent comment a header role during C compilation. The second span establishes when the tool processes a file containing the special import.

challenge.method: Check disabled builds and a preamble containing a static C variable.
challenge.results: Disabling cgo excludes the file. With cgo enabled, the comment serves as a header even though Go code cannot refer to that static variable.

limitations: This concerns the specified cgo tool's header handling. It does not guarantee availability on every target or permit every preamble declaration to be referenced from Go.
This verifies the documented behavior in the Go 1.23.0 cgo tool. Target availability and successful compilation of arbitrary preamble contents are outside the claim.
